newsitem.title: USA: Total Renal secures $1 bln bank facilities.
newsitem.headline: Total Renal secures $1 bln bank facilities.

text.p: Total Renal Care Holdings Inc said on Tuesday it has secured firm commitments for an aggregate of $1 billion in two senior bank facilities, which replace the company's existing $400 million line.
The $1 billion in capital will consist of a seven year $800 million revolving senior credit facility and a 10 year $200 million senior term facility.
The company said that it will use both facilities primarily for acquisitions worldwide and general corporate purposes.
Bank of New York Co Inc and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp have fully underwritten and co-arranged the credit facilities.

Victor Chaltiel, chairman, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement, "We now have the financial strength and resources to continue our successful program of aggressive yet disciplined acquisitions and de novo center openings for the foreseeable future."

Chaltiel added, "Combined with TRL's strong internal growth, the acquisition of patients financed under the increased credit facilities plus operating cash flow will allow the company to possibly double its size by the turn of the century."

In addition, Total Renal said it entered into a forward interest swap agreement of $200 million for a 10-year period beginning on September 30. This is in addition to the seven year $100 million interest swap agreement the company entered into last year.
Total Renal Care provides dialysis services for patients suffering from end stage renal disease.
